name: qualimetrix/qualimetrix
description: CLI tool for static analysis of PHP code - detects architectural mess and complexity issues

suggest.ext-pcntl: Allows signal-interruption cleanup for staged output targets and parallel-worker startup files
suggest.ext-posix: Required for process workers on Unix; also supports effective process ownership checks

scripts.install:js: cd html-report && ([ -d node_modules ] && echo 'node_modules present, skipping npm ci' || npm ci)

scripts-descriptions.setup-hooks: Configure git to use project hooks from .githooks/
scripts-descriptions.test:aggregate: Run verified PHPUnit suite shards for composer check, excluding live freshness oracles and gate end-to-end cases run by dedicated groups
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run PHPUnit tests with HTML and clover coverage reports (needs an active coverage driver)
scripts-descriptions.test:js: Run JS tests for HTML report (vitest)
scripts-descriptions.test:cross-tool: Run Python tests for cross-tool comparison and check coordinators
scripts-descriptions.dangling-names: Report every Qualimetrix\Tests name the tree spells and no file declares; 0 exactly the pinned census, 1 a name nobody pinned, 2 an unreadable input, 3 a pin that no longer dangles
scripts-descriptions.phar: Build build/qmx.phar with a pinned, checksum-verified box
scripts-descriptions.install:js: Install the HTML report viewer's npm dependencies from its lockfile, or report them as already present; takes no arguments
scripts-descriptions.check-leaks: Fail if tracked files contain developer home paths or private project names
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Build the website with mkdocs --strict; fails on broken links and other doc warnings
scripts-descriptions.benchmark:check: Run benchmark regression check for health score formulas
scripts-descriptions.benchmark:update: Update benchmark baselines with current scores (±10 margin)
scripts-descriptions.health:bench: Offline health-score bench over captured raw metrics: self-test, candidate formulas, criteria
scripts-descriptions.architecture:generate: Regenerate modular-architecture governance projections and inventories
scripts-descriptions.architecture:check: Validate the manifest and generated modular-architecture artifacts without writing
scripts-descriptions.enumeration:directives: Regenerate the authored @qmx-threshold enumeration from src
scripts-descriptions.enumeration:directives:check: Fail when that enumeration and the tree disagree, so the count is never repeated in prose
scripts-descriptions.suppression-snapshot: Regenerate the suppression composition snapshot; refuse inert suppressors in src/
scripts-descriptions.suppression-snapshot:check: Fail if the suppression composition snapshot is stale or src/ has inert suppressors, without writing
scripts-descriptions.html-bundle:check: Fail if html-report/dist/report.min.js was not built from the current html-report/src/, without writing
scripts-descriptions.selfcheck: Validate modular-architecture governance, then run Qualimetrix on its own source code
scripts-descriptions.selfcheck:analysis: Run Qualimetrix on its own source code after governance freshness has already been checked
scripts-descriptions.check: Run code tests, then PHPStan beside documentation, artifact and self-analysis checks
scripts-descriptions.check:code: What a code change invalidates: style, the dangling-name census, static analysis, tests
scripts-descriptions.check:docs: What a website change invalidates: a strict mkdocs build
scripts-descriptions.configuration:merge-table: Regenerate the table of how each configuration key combines across layers in website/docs/getting-started/configuration.md (EN and RU) from the section declarations
scripts-descriptions.configuration:merge-table:check: Fail if that table differs from what the section declarations generate
scripts-descriptions.check:artifacts: What a manifest, config or corpus change invalidates: every generated artifact against a fresh measurement
scripts-descriptions.check:self: What the product says about this repository: the qmx ratchet and the directive audit
scripts-descriptions.directives:narrow-control: Prove --sweep=narrow and --sweep=full agree verdict for verdict: the seeded fixture whole (every verdict and every refusal), its Silenced/ half (where a wrong-producer defect reaches the comparison), then src/. Cheapest signal first, because composer stops at the first run that fails
scripts-descriptions.directives:audit: Fail if any inline @qmx directive over src/ does nothing
scripts-descriptions.check:gate: Gate end-to-end tests and observed witnesses; required for finding-gate changes
scripts-descriptions.check:code:tests: Run style, verified PHPUnit shards, the name census, JavaScript and cross-tool tests
scripts-descriptions.check:parallel: Run PHPStan and the remaining validation groups concurrently, collecting both results
scripts-descriptions.check:remaining: Run documentation, generated-artifact and self-analysis checks in order
